args.description: a tall standing torch, isolated on transparent background, seen from directly in front. A straight dark wooden pole planted in a small base of stacked stones, topped by a bronze cup holding a bright burning flame of orange and yellow with a few sparks rising. Retro 16-bit pixel art, crisp pixels, flat readable shapes, no anti-aliasing.

a cluster of five ancient Greek clay wine amphorae standing and leaning together, isolated on transparent background, seen from beside them. Tall terracotta jars with two handles and pointed bases, some painted with simple black bands, one tipped over on its side with a crack, one propped against the others, a little red wine staining the ground beneath. Retro 16-bit pixel art, crisp pixels, flat readable shapes, no anti-aliasing.

a heavy wooden feasting bench knocked over onto its side, isolated on transparent background, seen from beside it. A long plain plank seat on four sturdy legs lying tipped over with its legs sticking out sideways, a dropped cushion and a spilled cup beside it. Retro 16-bit pixel art, crisp pixels, flat readable shapes, no anti-aliasing.

a sleek ancient Greek war galley moored and at rest, isolated on transparent background, seen from directly beside it. A long dark hull with a raised curved stern and a bronze ram at the bow, a row of oars pulled in and stacked upright, a single mast with a square sail half furled that is dyed deep red and painted with a dark boar emblem, a mooring rope trailing from the bow. No people. Retro 16-bit pixel art, crisp pixels, flat readable shapes, no anti-aliasing.
